# Protect Your DVOM from Overloads and Blown Fuses (VIDEO)


#### Description


Overloading your DVOM/multimeter can result in a blown fuse, and most techs won’t have a replacement on hand. Adding an inline circuit breaker can help protect your meter’s fuses and avoid delays in electrical diagnostic work.
